title: Interpretive Variation and Discourse Structure in Detecting Enthymemes in Controversial Political Discourse
abstract: arXiv:2610.30987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enthymemes are arguments that leave a premise or conclusion unstated, and they are a common persuasion device on social media. Because readers must fill in the missing part themselves, they often disagree on whether a text contains one. This paper asks how to detect and evaluate enthymemes when such disagreement is part of the task. On tweets about vaccination and immigration, each labeled by five annotators, F1 stalls around 0.67 for every fine-tuned model we train, regardless of data size, added features or label type. We therefore ask how these models should be evaluated instead, and propose metrics that compare predictions with the full distribution of annotator votes, together with a model that predicts this distribution directly and captures disagreement better at no cost in F1. We then ask what role discourse structure plays. Models learn to rely on explicit argumentative structure: they reliably recognize tweets without an enthym

translated_title: 争议性政治话语中省略三段论检测的解释差异与话语结构
translated_abstract: 省略三段论是指省略某个前提或结论的论证，它是社交媒体上常见的说服手段。由于读者必须自行补全缺失的部分，人们对某段文本是否包含省略三段论常常意见不一。本文探讨当这种分歧本身就是任务的一部分时，如何检测和评估省略三段论。在关于疫苗接种和移民的推文数据集上（每条推文由五位标注者标注），我们训练的所有微调模型的F1分数都停滞在0.67左右，无论数据规模、新增特征或标签类型如何变化。因此，我们转而探讨应如何评估这些模型，提出了将预测结果与标注者投票的完整分布进行比较的评估指标，并构建了一个直接预测该分布的模型，该模型能更好地捕捉标注者分歧，且不损失F1分数。随后，我们研究了话语结构所起的作用：模型学会依赖显式的论证结构，能够可靠地识别不含省略三段论的推文……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现在争议性政治话语中检测省略三段论时，由于标注者解释存在固有分歧，所有微调模型的F1均停滞在0.67左右，为此提出了基于标注者投票分布的新评估指标和直接预测该分布的模型，并揭示模型依赖显式论证结构进行识别。
en_tdlr: This study shows that fine-tuned models plateau at an F1 of ~0.67 when detecting enthymemes in controversial political discourse due to inherent annotator disagreement, and proposes distribution-based evaluation metrics and a model that directly predicts annotator vote distributions, while revealing that models rely on explicit argumentative discourse structure.
